datasets.name: Gaofen-1 (GF-1) Satellite imagery data
datasets.verbatim: In response to the on-site landslide case, five wide-swath panchromatic remote sensing images were captured using the Gaofen-1 satellite, and landslide recognition experiments were conducted based on the image data.

methods.name: Shallow landslide remote sensing identification method based on improved Otsu algorithm and multi-feature threshold
methods.summary: The method enhances remote sensing images using Retinex theory and guided filtering, extracts multi-feature scales and sliding window morphological features, and segments potential landslide areas using an improved Otsu algorithm optimized with a Monte Carlo iteration strategy.

availability.author_statement: "The original contributions presented in the study are included in the article/supplementary material, further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding authors."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom method code is not available.
